proWelcomeDesc: Congratulations on purchasing Stellar PRO. Our journey has just begun.
adDesc: Enjoying Stellar? Support our continuous development by upgrading to Stellar PRO as a donation option.
supportMeDesc: Unlock Stellar's full potential with advanced features, intelligent performance tuning, battery optimization, and daily system balance. Contact: skizo.prjkt@gmail.com
apiWarningDesc: API access is not enabled. Please enable it in Settings to use Stellar.
officialDev: Your build of Stellar is officially developed!
loveProjectDesc: If you enjoy using Stellar, please consider supporting the developer.
reportBugTitle: Found an issue or want to share feedback?
reportBugDesc: Let us know as soon as possible.
stellarAIConfigurationDesc: Exclusive extra features for supporters, providing experimental optimizations and specialized system tweaks
advancedDvfsDesc: Control CPU and GPU frequency scaling limits to balance performance and power consumption
storageLifespanDesc2: Check storage health status, wear level, and performance metrics
utilityToolDesc: Fine-tune adjustments for Stellar system utilities.
downscalingDescShort: Scale game rendering resolution down to reduce GPU load and boost performance.
aiConfigurationDesc: Extra Configuration is a new feature set under active development, offering specialized tweaks and experimental optimizations for project supporters with continuous dynamic tuning.
aiMasterSwitcherDesc: Enables heuristic workload prediction and automated tuning. When active, Stellar continuously calculates optimal hardware states in real time.
heuristicModeBatteryDesc: Keeps device cool and saves battery for casual gaming.
heuristicModeAdaptiveDesc: Smart balance between smooth frames and power efficiency.
heuristicModePerfDesc: Maximum frame stability and zero lag for competitive matches.
showToastDesc: Enable brief toast notifications regarding game optimizations, profile switches, and other system events.
bypassChargingDesc: Route power directly to the system board and pause battery charging cycles to reduce heat and battery wear. Hardware compatibility varies by manufacturer.
advDvfsDesc: DVFS lets you adjust the kernel CPU frequency floor for various workloads. For instance, default is 100%, and setting it to 80% limits the maximum frequency floor to 80%. Do not modify these values unless you fully understand their behavior.
storageLifespanDesc: Analyze storage health, eMMC or UFS wear levels, estimated lifespan, and performance benchmarks.
storageDiagnosticDefault: Tap "Run Test" to start storage diagnostics...
customizableDVFSDesc: Configure per-app DVFS policies for CPU and GPU frequency management.
hintDvfsGpu: Apply per-app GPU frequency limits to enable dedicated graphics throttling.
hintDvfsCpu: Apply per-app CPU frequency limits to enable dedicated processor throttling.
overpriorityDesc: Android scheduler priority level for targeted processes.
hintPrioGame: Raise scheduling priority for the game thread ID <tid>.
hintPrioMain: Apply priority focus optimizations to main process IDs <pid>.
gamePreloadersDesc: Preload game assets into memory to enhance runtime stability and prevent micro-stutters.
hintPreload: Enable asset preloading. Default mode is balanced for low or medium RAM; Maximum mode is optimized for high-capacity RAM devices.
doNotDisturbDesc: Block notifications, pop-ups, and screen overlays while the application is active.
refreshRateDesc: Set the target refresh rate limit for this app profile.
settingsDonateDesc: Support the ongoing development of Stellar
bannerDesc: Select a custom banner image from any Stellar release update
settingsChangelogDesc: View what is new in the latest release
loggingInfoDesc: Display system logs and diagnostic records
donating.footer.message: Every contribution significantly supports this project.
developerQuote: “If it works, do not touch it.”
aboutSection1Desc: Stellar was created out of enthusiasm and ambition. What began as a personal experiment quickly evolved into an effort to share valuable tools with the community.
aboutSection2Desc: Deeply grateful to the open developer community whose shared knowledge made this project possible. May Stellar serve as an effective tool and inspiration.
aboutSection3Desc: Your feedback is invaluable. We will continue rolling out updates to bring new features, polish existing tools, and ensure dependable system stability.
uninstallDesc: Remove module components or selectively clean up Stellar files
uninstallDialogDesc: Select components or directories to remove from your system:
uninstallFullModuleNotice: To completely uninstall Stellar, please remove the module directly from your module manager.
uninstallNoSelection: Please select at least one component to remove
stellarRemoved: Stellar has been restored to default settings.
downscalingRequiresAndroid12: Resolution downscaling requires Android 12 or higher
noLogsAvailable: No logs available at this time.
stellarHelperError: Ensure stellars is present and has proper execution permissions.
noDiagnosticOutput: No output received from diagnostic utility.
forceFastChargeDesc: Adjust charging protocols at the kernel level to draw higher charging currents beyond standard USB specifications
aiInfoDialogIntro: The Heuristic Engine operates across dynamic execution policies, utilizing runtime heuristics to orchestrate hardware resources efficiently.
aiInfoPerfDesc: Sustains peak core frequencies and GPU clocks for demanding workloads with relaxed thermal constraints.
aiInfoBattDesc: Enforces energy conservation by strictly monitoring battery drain, core thermals, and background polling rates.
aiInfoAdaptiveDesc: Autonomous engine that dynamically modulates CPU and GPU thresholds based on active foreground demands.
rendererDesc: Sets the global hardware-accelerated rendering and compositing backend for the Android UI.
rendererInfoNote: Modifies the underlying graphics engine utilized by the Android framework and SurfaceFlinger. Warning: Forcing an incompatible backend can cause severe visual artifacts, black screens, or bootloops depending on your GPU drivers. This setting applies globally to all 2D apps and system interfaces. Do not modify unless you understand the architectural implications.
rendererSwitcherDesc: Sets the rendering backend override for this application.
disableFrameRateDesc: Overrides vendor-imposed frame rate caps, dynamically matching games to the display's maximum refresh rate.
diagCriticalMsg: Verdict: Storage hardware is nearing failure.
diagExcellentMsg: Verdict: Storage is in pristine condition.
diagReadError: Error: Could not read storage health sensors.
backupSectionDesc: Back up your settings to restore anytime without manual reconfiguration, and share your setup code.
restoreSectionDesc: Restore previously saved settings and apply shared configuration codes.
restoreInvalid: Error: Invalid or corrupted backup code!
activationCardDesc: Activate license to unlock extra Stellar features through supporter donation
activationViewDesc: Enter your Gmail address to verify and unlock Pro status. A valid email address is required.
activationInvalidEmail: Invalid email format. Address must end with @gmail.com
activationEmailNotOnDevice: Email is not associated with any account on this device
activationNoAccounts: No Google accounts detected on this device
activationNoInternet: No internet connection. Please check your network.
activationServerConnectionFailed: Could not connect to license server. Please try again later.
activationEmailNotFound: Email address not found in license database
reduceRefreshRateDesc: Switch display to 60 Hz when Battery Saver is active to extend battery life.
cpuGovProfileDesc: Configure kernel CPU scaling governors across different system workload profiles
gpuGovProfileDesc: Assign dynamic GPU clock governors to balance graphics throughput and power consumption
ioSchedProfileDesc: Optimize storage queue scheduling algorithms to minimize read and write latency
cpuPowersavingDesc: Prioritizes lower core frequencies and gradual ramp-ups to minimize power consumption.
cpuBalancedDesc: Dynamically modulates CPU clock speeds according to real-time workload demands.
cpuGamingDesc: Locks high frequency floors and eliminates ramp-up delays for maximum computing throughput.
gpuPowersavingDesc: Limits GPU clocks and voltage states to maximize screen-on time.
gpuBalancedDesc: Scales GPU frequencies adaptively to match display refresh rate and compositor demands.
gpuGamingDesc: Forces maximum GPU clock frequencies to prevent frame drops and ensure smooth visuals.
ioPowersavingDesc: Batches storage I/O operations to optimize energy efficiency.
ioBalancedDesc: Provides balanced read and write queue prioritization for seamless multitasking.
ioGamingDesc: Minimizes storage queue latency for instantaneous asset streaming and faster load times.
screenRefreshRateDesc: Configure hardware display panel refresh rate profiles
customGovDesc: Select an individual governor for each profile instead of a single global governor.
screenRefreshDesc: Sets the default peak refresh rate across system settings. OEM behavior may vary. Alternatively, use Force Change Refresh Rate
lockFrequenciesDesc: Lock frequencies to the highest safe levels available within system boundaries.
hintLockGpu: Set GPU to the kernel maximum frequency floor for sustained peak performance.
hintLockCpu: Set CPU to the maximum frequency floor for peak computing capacity.
surfaceFlingerDesc: Automatically recalculates and applies adaptive SurfaceFlinger phase offsets based on the current stable refresh rate.
gmsDozeDesc: Pause background polling for Google Play Services to save battery. Not recommended for general stability
deviceSpoofDesc: Mask device identity as a flagship model to unlock restricted in-game graphics options
deviceSpoofBetaNotice: Device spoofing is currently in beta. Enable Apply On Boot to take effect during the next reboot. Warning: Some apps may exhibit unexpected behavior.
deviceSpoofApplyOnBootDesc: Inject selected device properties during the next reboot
deviceSpoofSearchPlaceholder: Search device model, brand, or chipset...
deviceSpoofDialogMsg: Applying device spoofing model '{0}'. Changes will take effect upon reboot.
forceChangeRefreshRateDesc: Use SurfaceFlinger hardware locks to seamlessly switch refresh rates, bypassing database restrictions
minRefreshRateDisabledNotice: Minimum refresh rate is locked while Force Change is active
killLoggerDesc: Disables kernel event tracing and background logging services to minimize I/O overhead. Not recommended: may cause system instability on certain ROMs.
